title: A vendor bill line holding a part later set inactive still saves
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks SV-12010 (Vendor bill: refuse an inactive part's number on a received line), which is not released yet. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-12010 is released.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part for this test, part A, with 4 on hand.
  • Create a received vendor bill for this test, bill A, with one stock line, line 1, for part A.
  • Set part A inactive after bill A was received.
  • Start on bill A (Parts in the top bar, Vendor Invoices in the left menu, then bill A).
custom_steps:
1. Click line 1's part number to change it.
  2. Click Save.
  3. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 1's part number can be changed and still holds part A.

Step 2:

  • The save goes through with part A's own number: no "is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." message shows.

Step 3:

  • Bill A reloads and line 1 still holds part A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 36 (3 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 4 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E2: “The user can still change the quantity, price and notes on that line, and save it again with the same part or number.”

From: Jira SV-12010 "Vendor bill: refuse an inactive part's number on a received line" (Task, Board Backlog, requested by Chris Ward in SV-10647 comment 79703; saved word for word in sources/jira-2026-11-04/SV-12010-2026-11-04.md), read 4 Nov 2026

  • SV-12010, Expected: “A line that already holds an inactive part can still be saved with its own number (S9-E2).”
